lessons_summary: Scalp only with 15m/M5 trend and momentum alignment, avoid fading into resistance, and enter only when setup is clean. Take partial/full profits quickly at the nearest liquidity or structural level on the first stall or reversal. Cut exposure before high-impact news to avoid slippage, spread spikes, and mean-reversion losses.
